newsitem.title: USA: American Heritage to buy Columbia Universal.
newsitem.headline: American Heritage to buy Columbia Universal.

text.p: American Heritage Life Insurance Co said on Wednesday that it has agreed in principle to acquire Columbia Universal Corp for $44 million in cash.
In a press release, American Heritage said that the acquisition will result in an increase in operating earnings per share. A company spokesman was not immediately available to clarify the timeframe.
The company said it expects the transaction, which is subject to approval by Columbia's shareholders, to be completed in the first quarter of 1997.

Columbia Universal, with assets of $360 million, is an Austin, Texas-based provider of annuity, supplemental health and individual life insurance products through its subsidiary, Columbia Universal Life Insurance Co.

Separately, American Heritage also said it is acquiring a block of payroll deduction, interest sensitive whole life business from Kentucky Home Mutual Life Insurance Co and its affiliate, Keystone Life Insurance Co. Premiums on this business are about $2.1 million with assets of about $4.5 million.
